reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getAverageFillCategories (shared shouldFillCategory rule), the sign flip from averageToBudgetAmount, and reads activity via getSheetValue/sheetForMonth like getCategoryAverage does.

duplication.why: Only the batchMessages/for/setBudget loop shape mirrors set3MonthAvg; no rule logic is copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the action, its handler type/registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent with siblings; the only wrinkle is reusing a helper named for averages for a single-month amount.
